title: Joint dry run: S4-B's compiled schema rows against the tables and the trace rows
question: Do S4-B's compiled schema-table rows load into meta.schema_*, register as a schema version from their hash, and agree with the trace rows inserted against that version?
method: results/s4/compiled/tables.json (S4-B, not yet recorded by S4) registered as schema version 0.2.0 (content hash recomputed from the listed sources), artifact bodies hash-checked, every schema_* row inserted under a savepoint; the twelve core units materialized on a run of that version; typed agreement checked in SQL and Python. PostgreSQL 18.6 (Ubuntu 18.6-1.pgdg24.04+2), pg_textsearch 1.5.1, vector 0.8.7, on the project-local cluster (just db-up; socket build/pg/run, port 5440, pg_textsearch preloaded); DDL applied and rows written as the NOLOGIN non-superuser cs_s6_app (SET ROLE) in cs_spike_s6 cloned from cs_template; psycopg 3.3.6 (binary), pgvector-python 0.5.1, spike venv checked against the lock (`uv sync --locked --check`: no changes) before the final run; free disk 109G at start, 106G at end.

agents.separation: coordinator brief; wrote only code/s6_*, code/s6*.py/.sql, results/s6/, records/s6.*

results.name: qualifier_keys_matching_only_prefixed
results.note: slot qualifiers prefixed (stat:param_values); claim qualifier keys bare

results.name: slot_class_refs_bare
results.note: domain_class/range bare while class names are prefixed

results.name: value_class_attribute_rows
results.note: schema_slot PK (schema_version_id, name) cannot hold v of two value classes; class folded into the name

results.name: parse_status_enum_vs_ddl
results.value: ParseStatus has 'ambiguous'; kb.segment/kb.rendition CHECKs do not

conclusion: The phase 0 path pack → compiled rows → migration-0001 tables → trace rows works: hashes recompute, all 148 compiled rows insert, and predicates, types, value kinds and enum values agree. What breaks joins is naming: class names and slot qualifiers are prefixed in the compiled rows, entity types and claim qualifier keys bare, and domain_class/range bare inside the compiled rows themselves; one convention is needed. Two DDL/D2 §7.1 findings: value-class attributes need the class in schema_slot's key, and ParseStatus 'ambiguous' is not in D3's parse_status CHECKs.
